title: Project Overview
message: This is a date management app for tracking inventory expiration dates. The backend uses Express with TypeScript and SQLite. The frontend uses React with Tailwind CSS.

title: Auth Pattern
message: Authentication uses JWT tokens with bcrypt for password hashing. The auth middleware validates tokens on protected routes. Sessions are stateless.

title: Expired Items Bug Fix
message: Fixed a bug where expired items were not being tracked in transactions. Added the expired_item_transactions table in migration 007. The solution was to create a separate transaction log for expired items to maintain audit history.

title: Controller Pattern
message: Controllers should be thin - only handle request/response. Business logic goes in services.
